description.value: R Ki Dessert Studio is a specialty dessert cafe operated by the R Ki Coffee Lab team, a Richmond-based specialty coffee roaster known for hosting cupping events featuring single-origin lots from Panama, Bolivia, and Peru. Located in a shopping complex on Hazelbridge Way in Richmond, the studio specializes in custom cakes and desserts available for pre-order through an online ordering system. Cyclists passing through Richmond's busy Hazelbridge corridor will find it a sweet stop for a break.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 33m; rack at 78m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website's R Ki Dessert Studio collection page confirms the OSM address (#180-4811 Hazelbridge Way, Richmond BC), phone (604-271-0278), and email (rkidessert@gmail.com), establishing the business is real and active. An external order link and a birthday cake pre-order product confirm the business is currently operating and accepts orders for pickup/takeout. The website's general Contact Us page lists a different address and phone for the parent brand (R Ki Coffee Lab at 110-8280 Lansdowne Rd) — that is a separate location and flagged as a concern. No cycling-specific amenities (bike racks, Wi-Fi, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: The website's Contact Us page lists a different address (110-8280 Lansdowne Rd, Richmond BC V6X0B2) and a different phone (604-278-0774) — this appears to be the parent R Ki Coffee Lab location, not the Dessert Studio. The Dessert Studio's own collection page confirms the OSM address and phone, so no correction is needed, but the two-location structure may cause confusion.
The OSM website URL points to a Shopify product collection page within the parent brand's store rather than a dedicated website for R Ki Dessert Studio specifically.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active business confirmed by website with a matching address, phone, and live product listings. Useful rest stop for cyclists in the Hazelbridge Way corridor.

Takeout.detail: Website states 'Order Link: https://microsite.talech.com/shop/R-KI-DESSERT-STUDIO-RICHMOND-BC/...' and notes the main site is for display only — orders placed through that external link, implying pickup/takeout fulfillment

wow_evidence: Richmond-based specialty coffee roaster known for hosting cupping events
